frontmatter.name: Josef Müller-Brockmann Swiss International Style
frontmatter.author: Bin
frontmatter.style_prompt_short: Grid-locked Swiss precision. Black and white base with electric blue accent. Helvetica only. Data visualizations as hero elements. Every frame snaps to a mathematical grid. Geometric, systematic, exact.
frontmatter.style_prompt_full: Josef Müller-Brockmann Swiss International Style. Grid-locked layouts with mathematical precision. Black and white base with ONE accent color (electric blue #0066FF). Strong diagonal compositions. Helvetica typography only. Data visualizations are the hero — animated charts, counters, grids. Every frame snaps to a grid. Transitions are horizontal grid wipes. No organic shapes. No gradients. No stock photography. Everything is geometric, systematic, precise.

accent.name: Electric Blue
accent.role: the ONE accent — data highlights, key emphasis

display.style: uppercase or sentence case, tight tracking

body.style: flush left, ragged right, generous leading

rules: Type sizes follow a mathematical scale

notes: Every element locked to the grid
Strong diagonal compositions within orthogonal grid
Data visualizations are the hero elements

motion.animation_style: Geometric precision. Elements snap to grid positions. Charts animate systematically. Counters tick mechanically. Nothing bounces.

mood.cultural_reference: Müller-Brockmann, Grid Systems in Graphic Design, Zurich School

frontmatter.name: Neville Brody Industrial Type
frontmatter.author: Teo @ HeyGen
frontmatter.style_prompt_short: Dark industrial typography. Compressed and distorted letterforms slamming into fractured grids with controlled aggression. Brody's late-80s broadcast harshness meets editorial tension.
frontmatter.style_prompt_full: A dark, experimental graphic system inspired by Neville Brody's late-80s and 90s typographic experimentation: industrial texture, compressed and expanded letterforms, media harshness, fractured alignment, and controlled aggression. Use charcoal black, steel gray, dirty white, signal red, and muted electric blue. Typography should feel engineered, distorted, and culturally loaded. Type should compress, stretch, split, and slam into grids with sharp industrial force. Visuals and text should collide rathe

rules: Type IS the visual — collides with content, not placed on it
Never center — always flush left or fractured

notes: Labels feel like broadcast control room overlays

motion.animation_style: Type slams into grid. No gentle easing. Elements collide.

mood.cultural_reference: Neville Brody, The Face magazine, Arena, Fuse

frontmatter.name: Saul Bass Cinematic Titles
frontmatter.author: Visual Style Gallery
frontmatter.style_prompt_short: Bold graphic cinema. Stark silhouettes, torn paper edges, dramatic contrast. Hitchcock-era title sequences brought to life.
frontmatter.style_prompt_full: Saul Bass cinematic title sequence style. Bold, graphic, dramatic. High contrast black and white with single accent color (orange-red #FF4500 or yellow #FFD700). Stark silhouettes and bold shapes. Torn paper edges and cut-out aesthetics. Hand-made feeling despite geometric precision. Dramatic reveals and transformations. Type integrated with image, not floating above it. Vertigo spirals, Anatomy of a Murder paper cut-outs, The Man with the Golden Arm typography. Strong diagonals. Motion is theatrical — elem

rules: Type is part of the image, not separate
Type can be fragmented, torn, or transformed

motion.animation_style: Theatrical reveals. Elements transform and rotate with purpose. Paper cut-out aesthetic — things assemble and disassemble. Jazz-influenced timing: syncopated, surprising, rhythmic.

mood.cultural_reference: Saul Bass, Vertigo, Anatomy of a Murder, The Man with the Golden Arm, Psycho
